57332211.jobTitle: AI Enablement Lead - Software & Product Engineering - Urgent Contract (outside IR35)
57332211.jobDescription:
AI Enablement Lead – Software & Product Engineering


6 to 12 month contract | Up to £1,250 per day | Outside IR35 | Manchester or London | Hybrid


We’re working with an established software and technology business looking to hire an AI Enablement Lead to help change the way its product and engineering teams build and deliver software.


This is not an AI strategy role, a research role or traditional change management.


We’re looking for someone genuinely hands on with GenAI who can work directly with software engineering and product teams to embed AI into the product development lifecycle.


The business has already started its AI journey. Teams are experimenting with the technology and there is good internal capability. The next step is bringing in somebody who is further ahead of that curve and has already applied this successfully within a commercial software environment.


What you’ll be doing


You’ll work directly with engineering and product teams, helping them move from experimenting with AI to using it as part of their everyday way of working.


That could include AI assisted software development, agents, skills, development workflows, automated testing and review, and new approaches to how software is planned, built and maintained.


Experience with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or comparable AI development tooling would be highly relevant.


You’ll embed with teams and work squad by squad, helping engineers understand what is possible, implementing new approaches and developing repeatable practices that can scale across the wider business.


There are already identified areas to tackle, but we also want someone curious enough to identify opportunities the business hasn’t considered yet.


Ultimately, this is about delivering measurable improvements in engineering productivity, efficiency and the value delivered to customers.


What we’re looking for


Your background could vary, but we’re particularly interested in people who have come through software engineering, product engineering or technology leadership and have subsequently gone deep into applied GenAI.


You don’t need five years of AI experience.


You do need meaningful, recent experience of actually applying GenAI within software and product development and be able to talk specifically about what you personally built, implemented or changed.


Relevant experience could include:

  • Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar AI development tooling
  • Agents, skills and agentic workflows
  • AI development harnesses and orchestration
  • AI assisted software engineering
  • Automated testing and code review
  • Embedding AI across the software and product development lifecycle
  • Taking engineering teams from experimentation into repeatable adoption
  • Measuring productivity and efficiency improvements


Technical credibility is important, but so is your ability to bring people with you. You’ll need to be comfortable working directly with engineers while communicating effectively with senior technology and product leaders.


The opportunity


6 months initially, with the potential to extend to 12 months.


Manchester or London preferred, with flexibility around hybrid working. Some face to face time will be valuable given the hands on nature of the role.


Up to £1,250 per day, Outside IR35.


If you’ve genuinely helped software engineering teams change the way they build products using AI, I’d be very interested in speaking.


*Only suitable candidates will be contacted*

57300205.jobDescription:
Engineering Manager

  • Annual Salary: £75,000 to £100,000+
  • Location: Slough
  • Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a dynamic engineering team within a modern FMCG manufacturing facility. This role offers the opportunity to manage a maintenance manager, a large engineering team, a controls engineer, and a team leader, focusing on enhancing planned maintenance, production, and all site engineering activities.

Day-to-day of the role:

  • Lead and develop a skilled team of engineers, ensuring the safe and efficient operation of manufacturing equipment.
  • Oversee planned preventative maintenance and coordinate engineering projects to improve system reliability and performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to strategic planning to enhance production processes and reduce downtime.
  • Promote and ensure high standards of health and safety across the site.
  • Manage and mentor direct reports including a maintenance manager, controls engineer, and team leader, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager or Supervisor within a manufacturing environment, ideally in FMCG.
  • Strong background in Engineering.
  • Qualified in an engineering background
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage large teams and complex engineering projects.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to drive process improvements.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, capable of motivating and leading a team towards achieving operational excellence.
  • Must be commutable to Sutton, South London.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary package including a bonus scheme.
  • Excellent benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement within a market-leading company.
  • Work in a highly autonomous and influential leadership role within a well-established manufacturing environment.

To apply for this Engineering Manager position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this leadership role.

57352594.jobTitle: Security & Network Engineer - 12 months Fixed term
57352594.jobDescription:
Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes MILWAUKEE, RYOBI, AEG - recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality.


We're seeking Security & Network Engineer who can architect and operationalise a secure, compliant, and agile network and infrastructure backbone. You'll own the design and governance of our network, security policies and infrastructure architecture across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments. More than a technician, you're a strategist: someone who shapes policy, educates stakeholders, and mentors teams to embed security thinking into every decision,without strangling velocity.
